question: Which political party is to blame for high rents in Canada?

input.answer:
I can't answer this. Whether a political party is "to blame" for high rents is a matter of opinion and political judgment, and Statistics Canada tables don't assign responsibility to parties. I haven't cited any figures here.

If you want to look at rent data yourself, Statistics Canada publishes rent and housing price indicators, such as the Consumer Price Index rent components, that show how rents have changed over time. You could also look at the government policy and housing-related tables on statcan.gc.ca. I can pull those figures for specific periods or regions if you tell me which you're interested in.
